record.oneLiner: A small, slender, early carnivorous dinosaur of the Late Triassic.
record.description: Coelophysis was a small, slenderly built, bipedal carnivore from the Late Triassic of the southwestern United States, up to about 3 m long. One of the earliest known dinosaur genera, it is among the most specimen-rich — famous mass-death assemblages at Ghost Ranch preserve hundreds of individuals.

notableFacts.text: One of the earliest known dinosaurs.
Known from hundreds of individuals, including the famous Ghost Ranch death assemblages.
